claim_text:
This enhances the efficiency of water use at the Nova Operation

label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: The claim is not clearly supported because the report provides a qualitative explanation of wastewater recycling, but does not provide direct quantitative evidence showing improved water-use efficiency or reduced reliance on groundwater extraction.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that an unspecified action “enhances the efficiency of water use” at the Nova Operation and “reduces our reliance on groundwater extraction.” No evidence was provided describing the action taken, any measured change in water-use efficiency, any groundwater extraction volumes, or before/after results at Nova. Without qualitative specifics or quantitative data showing improved efficiency or reduced groundwater reliance, the claim is not substantively verified by the provided evidence.
